label: It is impossible that there be no mover that is not MOVED_BY_ANOTHER_2, by another
meaning: Physics VIII.5, 256a13-21: a mover not moved by another cannot be lacking. Not a transcription: induction on accessibility, and premisesNeeded shows each of the three premises is needed. The conclusion is weaker than the prima via's STMT-FIRST-UNMOVED-MOVER-CANNOT-BE-LACKING (the first mover may move itself). Connects results; closes nothing. Scope: its `MovedIn` is shared with the prima via's observation premise; the result is accepted only under a physical instantiation, on which that premise reports sensible (physical) motion (DISAMB-MOTION). The induction consumes the additional accessibility commitment STMT-NO-INFINITE-SERIES-OF-MOVERS-MOVED-BY-ANOTHER, which has no source claim; the weaker source-level prohibition STMT-NO-INFINITE-DISTINCT-MOVERS-MOVED-BY-ANOTHER is not a substitute for it.
